text:
Anya (Product): Quick sync on /keys UI before QA. Want to lock copy and behaviors for rotate/revoke + empty state.
Diego (Design): cool. I pushed a new frame to Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd/keys-v2 (see empty state + modals). Notes below.
Anya (Product): empty state feels important for first-time orgs. current language is generic. propose: 'Create an API key to start sending requests. We recommend granting only the scopes needed.' CTA: 'Create key' (primary) and secondary 'Learn about scopes'.
Priya (Eng): dev note: when user clicks Create key we should show the key in a modal and then mask it after they click Done or 10s. we must be explicit: this is the only displayed value.
Omar (Security): can we offer a downloadable .txt with the key and a reminder to store in a secret manager? some enterprise customers will want that.
Diego (Design): added a small link 'Download key (recommended for production)' under the key. Also include a tiny sample .env snippet:
```
REDFWOOD_API_KEY=sk-xxxx
```
Anya (Product): good. how about rotate vs revoke wording? users conflate them.
Diego (Design): propose labels: 'Rotate key (create replacement)' and 'Revoke key (remove access)'. In the revoke modal: headline 'Revoke key permanently?' and a secondary 'Temporarily disable' option.
Nina (Support): please surface "last used" info in the key list row. customers ask "is this safe to rotate now?" Always include timezone on timestamp. Also show "used by" if available.
Priya (Eng): we can show "Last used 2h ago (UTC)" and a tooltip listing up to 5 routes. this will be async fetch. show skeleton while loading.
Omar (Security): must redact high-cardinality route params (ids, emails). Only show path templates.
Diego (Design): noted. UI will show "/api/v1/ingest/{org_id}" not full values.
a11y-bot: Reminder: copy that uses "only time" may be ambiguous to screen readers. Recommend "This key is shown once and will be masked afterwards." Also ensure Show key button has aria-controls to focus the key region.
Anya (Product): good catch. change copy to that.
Priya (Eng): about revoke flow: engineering suggests an optional 'grace period' toggle during rotate so old key is active for N days. default 3 days. must show clear indicator in the key card when key is in grace (orange pill: 'Rotating, active for 3d').
Nina (Support): Can we add a line in rotate modal: 'Notify team of key rotation' with an email checkbox? many customers forget to push new key.
Omar (Security): automated notification is fine but must respect org notification settings. Also add an audit entry explaining who rotated the key and why (free text reason).
Diego (Design): For the revoke modal, copy draft: 'Revoking this key will immediately stop all requests authenticated with it. If you need a temporary stop, choose "Temporarily disable".' Buttons: 'Revoke permanently' (danger) and 'Temporarily disable' (secondary).
a11y-bot: Modal keyboard order: trap focus. First focus on modal title. After confirm, move focus back to key row and announce via live region: 'API key revoked'. Ensure color isn't sole indicator for status pills.
Anya (Product): what about the inline copy for minimal scopes? I like a subtle callout: 'Recommended minimal scopes reduce blast radius.'
Diego (Design): callout is in place. color: pale teal, left icon. will include dashed border for non-color cue.
Priya (Eng): small API example in help drawer for how to rotate programmatically:
```
POST /v1/keys/rotate
{ "key_id": "k_123" }
```
Response includes new_key. remind users this only appears once.
Nina (Support): I'll prepare FAQ snippets for the modals: "What happens to clients using the old key?" -> "If the old key is revoked, they will immediately fail. If rotating with grace period, they will continue to work until grace ends."
Omar (Security): request: add a control in Dedicated/private to require typed confirmation (type REVOKE) for high-risk orgs.
Diego (Design): added note in dev spec: optional 'typed confirm' mode controlled by org policy.
a11y-bot: Also test copy button behavior: the copy action should announce 'API key copied to clipboard' via aria-live and not rely on color.
Anya (Product): action items: Diego: finalize Figma frames + accessible annotations. Priya: implement ephemeral key modal + last-used async fetch + grace-period state. Omar: policy toggle for typed-confirm. Nina: FAQs + support cases to test. a11y-bot: run checklist on staging. Demo on Thursday.
Diego (Design): will do.
Priya (Eng): will start backend tasks today.
Omar (Security): acknowledging.
Nina (Support): will test flows tomorrow and collect edge cases. :white_check_mark:
